schema.text: When you travel by car, do you feel less secure from crime or harassment where there are few people around (isolated or deserted areas)?

ar.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: عند التنقل بالسيارة، هل يقلّ شعورك بالأمان من الجرائم أو التحرش في الأماكن التي يقلّ فيها الناس (المناطق المعزولة أو المهجورة)؟

de.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: Fühlen Sie sich bei Autofahrten dort, wo wenige Menschen sind (abgelegene oder menschenleere Orte), weniger sicher vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?

en.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: When you travel by car, do you feel less secure from crime or harassment where there are few people around (isolated or deserted areas)?

fa.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: هنگام سفر با خودرو، آیا در جاهایی که آدم کمی هست (مناطق خلوت یا متروک) در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت کمتری می‌کنید؟

fr.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, vous sentez-vous moins à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement là où il y a peu de monde (zones isolées ou désertes) ?

hu.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: Autós utazás közben kevésbé érzi magát biztonságban a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szemben ott, ahol kevés ember van (elhagyatott vagy néptelen helyeken)?

it.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: Quando viaggi in auto, ti senti meno al sicuro da reati o molestie dove c’è poca gente (zone isolate o deserte)?

tr.#When you travel by car, do you feel les: Arabayla yolculuk ederken etrafta az insan olan yerlerde (ıssız veya tenha alanlarda) kendinizi suça veya tacize karşı daha az güvende hissediyor musunuz?
